original_code_license: GPL-2.0-or-later (files marked GPL-2.0-only stay GPL-2.0-only); the combined binaries are distributed under GPL-2.0 (LICENSE, kb #843)

license_references.LicenseRef-DejaVu-Fonts: The Bitstream Vera Fonts licence together with the DejaVu changes (public domain) and the Arev Fonts licence, exactly as gpu/third_party/fonts/LICENSE-DejaVu.txt states it. Not the SIL OFL.
license_references.LicenseRef-Bundled-Libraries: Libraries psport links from Nix (the Linux bundle's lib/) or from MSYS2 CLANG64 (the Windows bundle's DLLs), and packages compiled into its binaries. Each keeps its own licence; packaging/licences.nix and tools/win32-bundle.sh write them, with their licence texts and source URLs, into the THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES and SOURCES.txt of every bundle. Nothing under the Apache-2.0 or GPL-3.0-only is allowed in a bundle (tools/check_bundle_licences.sh).
license_references.LicenseRef-bbsc-gameserver: scripts/bbsc_gameserver/NOTICE.txt states GPL-2.0-or-later for BBSC (Copyright 2026 CLS_AMG). The folder also holds LICENSE.NoDreamForHunter, the MIT licence of NoDreamForHunter by fhody125-web, whose ss.info format, endpoint list and JSON shapes bbsc_gameserver.py takes; bbhost_service.py is written from bbhost's client source (GPL-3.0-or-later per FORK.md) and states no licence of its own. The two statements are not reconciled: see the provenance of the component.
license_references.LicenseRef-Tracy-unverified: FORK.md and README.md list Tracy as BSD-3-Clause; the submodule is not checked out here, so its licence file was not read.
license_references.LicenseRef-game-patch-authors: patches/Bloodborne.xml carries patches whose authors are named in each Metadata element (Kyo, illusion, auser1337, Lance McDonald, emoose, Dasaav and others). No licence is stated for them anywhere in the repository.
license_references.LicenseRef-dxil-spirv-patch: A patch against dxil-spirv (https://github.com/HansKristian-Work/dxil-spirv, listed as MIT in README.md). The upstream licence file is not in the repository and was not read.
license_references.LicenseRef-msys2-pkgbuild: A PKGBUILD derived from MSYS2's mingw-w64-ffmpeg recipe (MINGW-packages). It states license=('spdx:LGPL-2.1-or-later') for the FFmpeg it builds, which is not the licence of the recipe file; the recipe's own licence is not stated in the repository.

components.name: psport runtime, GPU glue, launcher and build tooling
components.provenance: LICENSE (GPL version 2) and README.md: files marked GPL-2.0-only are under version 2 only, the rest is GPL-2.0-or-later used as version 2. About 640 files carry SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later; src/, gpu/shim and gpu/platform carry no per-file header, so for them README.md is the only statement. Origin: bbport (https://github.com/deadinside28/bloodborne_pc, GPL-2.0-or-later, last merged 3c57da4), ports by hand recorded in FORK.md with their source commits, from SrShadowy/bloodborne_pc (GPL-2.0) and Teefpyre/bloodborne_pc-LinuxBBSCFix (licence not recorded in FORK.md).

components.name: Per-title game profiles
components.provenance: All 59 files carry SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later. The BBSC co-op code under gpu/games/bloodborne/net is Copyright 2026 CLS_AMG (BBSC, GPL-2.0-or-later per scripts/bbsc_gameserver/NOTICE.txt) and ported by hand, see FORK.md.

components.name: libSceNgs2 port from AnyPS5
components.provenance: FORK.md, Ported components: libSceNgs2 from https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5 commit 5edae353, GPL-2.0-only. The files carry SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only, except Exports.cpp and ngs2_compat.hpp, which carry GPL-2.0-or-later (the glue to libpsport-gpu); Envelope.cpp, Filter.cpp, Limiter.cpp, PeakMeter.cpp and Vag.cpp carry no header (Limiter.cpp is written from firmware 11.00, not from AnyPS5; the origin of the other four is not recorded). Linked into libpsport-gpu.so, so the binary is GPL-2.0, never GPL-3.0 (kb #843).

components.name: libSceAudiodec and the native libSceNgs2
components.provenance: psport's own code; every source file carries SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later. gpu/audiodec (kb #624) replaces the AnyPS5 a11c8f7f port and keeps none of its code: NIDs, structure layouts and error codes are the API's, the contract of each export was read as facts from AnyPS5's Export.cpp (FORK.md), and it decodes through FFmpeg's libavcodec (LGPL-2.1-or-later, a bundled library) and LibAtrac9 (MIT, its own component). gpu/ngs2 (kb #625) is the native libSceNgs2, written from firmware 11.00 over shadPS4's Ngs2 headers (part of the shadPS4 vendored tree).

components.name: shadPS4 vendored tree
components.provenance: https://github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4 commit b4e7ae776071ceb1dd35004577a8719481e1d258 (gpu/VENDOR.txt, GPL-2.0-or-later; gpu/shadps4/LICENSE is GPL version 2) plus the later fixes backported by hand that gpu/VENDOR.txt lists. Local changes are marked psport:. Other copyright holders in the SPDX lines (yuzu, Citra, Dolphin, shadLauncher4) are GPL-2.0-or-later too; files under other licences are the next component.

components.name: Online module (libpsport-net.so)
components.provenance: FORK.md: shadp2p (a shadPS4 fork) by way of the Linux and Windows co-op forks of bbport, inherited with bbport 0.51 (3c57da4). Headers say GPL-2.0-or-later, except gpu/net/shadps4/core/libraries/np/np_handler.{h,cpp} and gpu/net/shadps4/shadnet/client.{h,cpp}, GPL-2.0-only. Copyright holders in the SPDX lines: shadPS4 Emulator Project, rpcs3 Project, rpcsn Project, shadNet Project, CLS_AMG. A separate shared library that links OpenSSL (Apache-2.0), protobuf, nlohmann_json, zlib and miniupnpc (gpu/CMakeLists.txt, gpu/net/CMakeLists.txt, shell.nix). OpenSSL and abseil are Apache-2.0, which GPL-2.0 does not allow, so no public bundle carries it until kb #850 replaces them.

components.name: cpp-httplib
components.provenance: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib, Copyright (c) 2017 yhirose (gpu/third_party/httplib/LICENSE). Used by the online module only. The upstream commit or version is not recorded in the repository.

components.name: FSR-Vulkan and AMD FidelityFX SDK sources
components.provenance: https://github.com/FireBurn/FSR-Vulkan at c64f093 (FORK.md); LICENSE.txt is MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Q2RTX FSR Vulkan contributors, for the portability layer outside upstream/. upstream/ffx-1.1.4 is AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (c6efa6bf7f2027b3ec94f28578bb5965eabb9e55) and upstream/ffx-2.3.0 the FSR SDK v2.3.0 subset (60f4ea81909200d8542eca14dccb2628b763a9a3); every one of their 288 files carries AMD's MIT permission notice. components.name: psport documentation

components.name: Libraries linked into the bundles
components.provenance: Not in the tree. The Linux bundle's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES and SOURCES.txt come from packaging/licences.nix and licences.py; the Windows bundle's from tools/win32-bundle.sh (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, SOURCES.txt, BUILD-INFO.txt). FFmpeg is built as LGPL-2.1-or-later (shell.nix; packaging/windows/ffmpeg). Also compiled in or fetched at build time: Boost, magic_enum (v0.9.7), robin-map, Vulkan Memory Allocator, Vulkan-Headers (Apache-2.0 OR MIT, used under the MIT), Zydis, miniz (3.1.2).
